name: Warm Mushroom Farro Bowl
ingredients: ½ cup cooked farro (contains gluten) or barley
1 tsp soy sauce and ½ tsp dried thyme
steps: Dry-sauté the mushrooms for 6 minutes until browned and their liquid has evaporated.
Add the oil, garlic, thyme and tofu and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the soy sauce and the spinach and cook for 2 minutes until wilted.
Fold in the farro and warm through.
Finish with pepper and lemon juice.
note: Browning the mushrooms in a dry pan concentrates the umami flavour.
